topic: What interference mitigation techniques are viable for overlapping service transmissions across geographically dispersed ground stations?
consensus_response: Viable techniques include adaptive frequency allocation, rate splitting, and common message decoding. Polarization diversity can also mitigate interference by utilizing orthogonal polarizations, increasing transmission capacity without sacrificing integrity. However, this technique may incur a budget cost due to reduced array factor.
reference_context: Research highlights importance of interference mitigation in satellite-terrestrial communications, citing techniques like rate splitting and adaptive frequency allocation.
